gloss: daily rate; prorated by the day

definitions.gloss: daily rate; prorating by the day; per diem calculation
definitions.explanation: Dividing a total amount (typically rent, salary, or fees) by the number of days to calculate a daily rate. Used when charges need to be prorated for a partial period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日割|ひわ}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}する→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧。
examples.english: The rent is calculated on a daily basis.

examples.japanese: ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入居|にゅうきょ}→入居：08630_nyuukyo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{日割|ひわ}り⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧になった。
examples.english: Since I moved in mid-month, the rent was prorated by the day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日割|ひわ}り{計算|けいさん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{支払|しはら}われた→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
examples.english: The salary was paid based on a daily prorated calculation.

notes: Composed of ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (day) + {割|わ}り (division, rate). Common compounds: {日割|ひわ}り⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧ (prorated rent), {日割|ひわ}り{計算|けいさん} (daily proration), {日割|ひわ}り⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ (daily rate charge). Frequently encountered when moving into or out of an apartment mid-month, or when starting/ending a subscription partway through a billing period. Related: ⟦{月割|つきわ}り→月割り：26344_tsukiwari⟧ (monthly rate), ⟦{時間割|じかんわり}→時間割：08552_jikanwari⟧ (timetable/schedule).
